title: Use the Apologist Icon for the Apologist chat provider by default
summary: Since the last plan (commit `0fe5f77`), the way the app draws every profile picture changed: pictures are now shown as normal images instead of backgrounds, so the new Apologist icon also appears in the built app and not just on developers' computers. Overall, the Apologist AI now has its own picture in chats: a dark square with a purple cross. Before this change, unless the link included a custom icon, Apologist showed the same kind of colored animal placeholder as any picture-less participant. A custom icon given in the link (`apologistIconUrl`) still replaces the default one.

preview.label: Open the preview build (with Apologist installed)

setup.title: Open the preview build
setup.body: Use Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari on a computer. Open the preview link at the top of this page. It ends in `?autoinstall-ext_Apologist=true`, which installs the Apologist AI for you. If the page shows an error or doesn't load, the build may still be deploying: wait a few minutes and reload. If it looks like an older version of Seed Bible, do a hard refresh: **Ctrl+Shift+R** (Windows) or **Cmd+Shift+R** (Mac).

setup.title: Sign in
setup.body: Sign in with your email address. Seed Bible emails you a code to type in, so use an inbox you can check. A private/incognito window gives you a clean start if anything looks odd.

setup.title: Know what the new icon looks like
setup.body: The new Apologist icon is a **dark navy square with a purple cross** in the middle. The old look, which you should no longer see for Apologist, was a colored circle with an animal on it.

tests.title: Apologist's messages show the new icon
steps: Open **John 3**.
Select **John 3:16** and click **Ask AI**. If a menu of AIs opens, pick **Apologist**.
Send the message and wait for Apologist to answer.
expected: The chat panel opens and Apologist replies.
Next to Apologist's reply, its picture is the dark square with the purple cross: not a colored animal, and not an empty circle with just a colored border.
The picture is sharp and fills its circle or square neatly (not stretched, cut off oddly, or shown as a broken-image symbol).
tests.why: Changed since commit `0fe5f77`: the code review found that on the preview build this picture showed as an empty circle. The new commit is meant to fix that, so check closely that the picture actually appears.

tests.title: The participant list shows the new icon for Apologist
tests.before: Keep the chat from the last test open.
steps: At the top of the chat panel, open the **Participants** list.
Find **Apologist** in the list.
expected: Apologist's picture in the list is the dark square with the purple cross.
Your own entry still shows your profile picture or your usual placeholder, unchanged.

tests.title: The icon still shows after a reload
steps: Reload the page (**F5**, or **Cmd+R** on Mac).
Open the same chat again from the chat panel.
expected: Apologist's earlier reply still shows the dark square with the purple cross.

tests.title: The icon is easy to see in dark mode
tests.why: The icon has a dark background, so it could blend into a dark theme.
steps: Switch Seed Bible to dark mode in its settings.
Open the chat with Apologist's reply.
expected: The purple cross is clearly visible and the icon doesn't disappear into the background.

tests.title: The icon fits on a phone-width screen
steps: Open the preview link on a phone, or make the browser window as narrow as it goes.
Open the chat with Apologist's reply.
expected: Apologist's picture shows the purple cross and isn't squashed or overlapping the message text.

sections.title: A custom icon in the link still wins
sections.intro: Organizations can give Apologist their own picture by adding `apologistIconUrl` to the link. That must keep working.

tests.title: A link with apologistIconUrl shows that picture instead of the default
steps: Open this address in the same browser: `https://alpha.seedbible.org/b/feature_aplogist-icon/cad20d53a6e345335eee51878630c41dd39cf989?autoinstall-ext_Apologist=true&apologistIconUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2FHelloAOLab.png`
Open **John 3**, select **John 3:16**, click **Ask AI** (pick **Apologist** if asked), send it and wait for the reply.
expected: Apologist's picture on the new reply is the HelloAO logo from GitHub, not the dark square with the purple cross.

tests.title: Without apologistIconUrl, the default icon comes back
steps: Open the preview link at the top of this page again (it has no `apologistIconUrl`).
Start a new message to Apologist and wait for the reply.
expected: Apologist's picture on the new reply is the dark square with the purple cross again.

sections.title: Shared chats
sections.intro: Optional: needs a second browser or a second person.

setup.title: Get a second browser
setup.body: Use a second browser (for example Chrome and Firefox) or a private/incognito window, signed in with a different email address. In both, open the preview link at the top of this page.

tests.title: Other people in a shared chat see the new icon for Apologist
tests.why: Apologist's picture is sent to everyone in a shared chat, so it must load for them too. The earlier code review expected this to fail (the picture isn't shared with other people yet), and the new commit doesn't change that, so note exactly what the second browser shows.
steps: In the first browser, start a shared session and invite the second browser into it.
In the first browser, ask Apologist a question in the session's chat and wait for the reply.
Look at the chat in the second browser.
expected: In both browsers, Apologist's reply shows the dark square with the purple cross, not a broken-image symbol or a colored animal.

sections.title: Things that should not have changed

tests.title: Your own profile picture still shows
tests.why: New since commit `0fe5f77`: every profile picture in the app is now drawn a different way, so people's real photos need checking too.
tests.before: You need a profile picture. If you don't have one, open **Account settings**, choose **Update picture**, pick any photo with **Upload from device**, and click **Set picture**.
steps: Look at your picture in the side bar of the app.
Open a chat and send a message, then look at the picture next to your message.
expected: Both places show your photo, filling its circle neatly: not stretched or squashed, not cut off oddly, and not a broken-image symbol or an empty circle.

tests.title: People without a profile picture still get the animal placeholder
tests.why: New since commit `0fe5f77`: the change only affects people who have a picture, so the placeholders must look as before.
steps: Open a private/incognito window, open the preview link at the top of this page, and don't sign in.
Look at the account picture in the side bar.
expected: It shows the usual account icon or colored animal placeholder, the same as on the live Seed Bible site.

tests.title: Profile pictures in shared sessions and the Discover panel still show
tests.why: New since commit `0fe5f77`: these places use the same picture code.
tests.before: Optional: needs the second browser from the Shared chats section, with a profile picture on at least one account.
steps: Join the same shared session in both browsers.
Look at the list of people in the session.
In one browser, write a note on **John 3:16**, then open **Discover** for John 3 and look at the notes.
expected: Each person's photo shows in the session list and next to notes, filling its circle neatly. People without a photo show their placeholder.

tests.title: Apologist's name and answers are unchanged
steps: In any chat with Apologist, look at its name and send one more question.
expected: It's still called **Apologist** and answers normally.

notCovered: Behind-the-scenes check that the icon file is bundled into the app correctly. If it weren't, the tests above would show a broken picture, so they cover it indirectly.
